xpPolicy.note: Quest rewards are the current values published by WOWF.IO after Forever's October 1 balance pass. That pass halved only the extra dungeon-quest bonus beyond normal quest values; it did not revert rewards to original Classic values. Mob and boss-clear XP stays player-observed until Forever publishes authoritative per-clear values.
